2) Recall that the change in frequency ($q$) of a recessive allele $A_2$ under complete dominance and negative selection is $\Delta q = \frac{-spq^2}{1-sq}$. Which coefficient values will lead to greatest single-generation decrease in $A_2$?

   a) $s$=0.1, $q$=0.5, $p$=0.5 
   b) $s$=0.1, $q$=0.1, $p$=0.9 
   c) $s$=0.01, $q$=0.1, $p$=0.9 
   d) $s$=0.01, $q$=0.01, $p$=0.99
